original_experiment_evidence: The study prepared and characterized GA-FA-CSLNs and evaluated them in Huh-7 cells, tumor-bearing mice, and rats.
identifiable_lnp_evidence: The delivery system is identified as a cantharidin-loaded solid lipid nanoparticle.
supported_payload_evidence: The payload is cantharidin, a natural antitumor agent, rather than mRNA, siRNA, saRNA, or circRNA.
target_cell_evidence_text: The abstract claims hepatocyte targeting but reports testing in the Huh-7 hepatocellular carcinoma cell line.
formulation_outcome_linkage_evidence: GA-FA-CSLNs are linked to cellular uptake, IC50, apoptosis, tumor inhibition, survival, safety, and pharmacokinetic outcomes.
notes: Excluded at abstract screening because the payload is outside the configured RNA scope.

original_experiment_evidence: The study experimentally varied dendrimer lipid grafting and measured surface hydrophobicity, plasma stability, protein adsorption, and tissue and cell delivery.
identifiable_lnp_evidence: The tested systems are identified as dendrimer-based lipid nanoparticles.
supported_payload_evidence: The title identifies the application as tissue-selective mRNA delivery.
target_cell_evidence_text: The study reports that reducing dLNP surface hydrophobicity diminished targeting of liver hepatocytes.
formulation_outcome_linkage_evidence: Changes in dendrimer lipid grafting and surface hydrophobicity are linked to plasma behavior, protein adsorption, hepatocyte targeting, and extrahepatic delivery.
notes: Included for detailed extraction. Paper-level inclusion does not establish COMET compatibility.

original_experiment_evidence: The study reports intravenous mRNA-LNP delivery experiments in healthy, fibrotic, cirrhotic, and tumor-bearing liver models.
identifiable_lnp_evidence: The tested delivery systems are explicitly identified as mRNA lipid nanoparticles.
target_cell_evidence_text: Intravenous mRNA-LNP delivery reportedly transfected virtually all hepatocytes in healthy, fibrotic, and cirrhotic liver.
formulation_outcome_linkage_evidence: Systemically delivered mRNA-LNPs are linked to hepatocyte transfection and protein-expression outcomes in normal and tumor-bearing liver.
notes: Included for detailed extraction. Exact LNP composition must be confirmed from full text.

original_experiment_evidence: The abstract explicitly describes the publication as a state-of-the-art review and overview.
identifiable_lnp_evidence: The review discusses mRNA-LNP base-editing examples but does not report its own tested LNP.
supported_payload_evidence: siRNA and mRNA payloads are discussed, but they are not tested in an original experiment reported by this publication.
target_cell_evidence_text: Hepatocyte-specific delivery is discussed in the review without an original cell-specific experiment.
formulation_outcome_linkage_evidence: No original tested LNP formulation is linked to a measured outcome in this review.
notes: Excluded because it summarizes other studies rather than reporting an original experiment.

original_experiment_evidence: The authors developed mannosylated LNPs and tested their cell-specific delivery following intravenous administration in mice.
identifiable_lnp_evidence: The tested LNPs incorporate mannose-conjugated cholesterol, with additional PEG-lipid acyl-chain modifications.
target_cell_evidence_text: The study reports significantly greater LNP uptake and functional mRNA delivery in CD206-positive Kupffer cells.
formulation_outcome_linkage_evidence: Mannosylated cholesterol and shorter PEG-lipid acyl chains are linked to increased Kupffer-cell uptake and functional mRNA delivery.
notes: Included for detailed extraction; the paper also contains direct LSEC evidence.

original_experiment_evidence: The study prepared copper-64-labeled mRNA-LNPs and performed PET pharmacokinetic experiments in normal and functionally deficient mice.
identifiable_lnp_evidence: The tested system is a common-composition mRNA-LNP labeled with copper-64 through an oligonucleotide-hybridization method.
target_cell_evidence_text: The study quantifies Kupffer-cell uptake and reports its contribution relative to hepatocyte uptake in hepatic clearance.
formulation_outcome_linkage_evidence: The radiolabeled mRNA-LNP system is linked to liver accumulation, protein-corona timing, clearance, cell uptake, and reporter expression.
notes: Included for detailed extraction; Kupffer uptake is measured even though hepatocyte uptake is greater.

original_experiment_evidence: The study used real-time intravital imaging to investigate LNP uptake and expression in liver cells in vivo and tested multiple modifications.
identifiable_lnp_evidence: The study tests mRNA-LNPs, siRNA-LNPs, co-encapsulated payloads, and an LNP containing a different ionizable lipid.
supported_payload_evidence: The tested payloads include Egfp mRNA and siRNA.
target_cell_evidence_text: Kupffer cells showed rapid LNP uptake, while Egfp mRNA translation was not substantially detected in the non-parenchymal cells.
formulation_outcome_linkage_evidence: The tested mRNA-LNP, siRNA-LNP, co-encapsulation, base-substitution, and ionizable-lipid conditions are linked to uptake and translation outcomes.
notes: Included because both uptake and functional expression outcomes are directly measured; lack of expression is still relevant evidence.

original_experiment_evidence: The study administered luciferase, HGF, and EGF mRNA-LNPs in mouse liver models and measured transfection, expression, and regeneration.
identifiable_lnp_evidence: The tested systems include nucleoside-modified luciferase, HGF, and EGF mRNA encapsulated in lipid nanoparticles.
supported_payload_evidence: The tested payloads are nucleoside-modified mRNAs.
target_cell_evidence_text: The study reports that a subpopulation of Kupffer cells was transfected after intravenous mRNA-LNP administration.
formulation_outcome_linkage_evidence: The administered mRNA-LNP systems are linked to cell transfection, protein expression, hepatocyte proliferation, regeneration, and liver-function outcomes.
notes: Included for Kupffer screening because direct transfection is reported, although hepatocytes are the study's primary biological focus.

original_experiment_evidence: The study administered CRISPR-Cas9 mRNA LNPs to hemophilia A mice and measured gene editing and FVIII activity.
identifiable_lnp_evidence: The delivery system is identified as an optimized MC3-based LNP formulation.
supported_payload_evidence: The LNP payload includes Cas9 mRNA together with a specifically designed sgRNA.
target_cell_evidence_text: Sequencing showed an average gene-editing rate of 15.3 percent in LSECs.
formulation_outcome_linkage_evidence: Optimized MC3 LNP treatment is linked to LSEC gene editing, sustained endogenous FVIII activity, and frameshift correction.
notes: Included for detailed extraction; COMET compatibility remains a later readiness question.

original_experiment_evidence: The study developed two pH-sensitive cationic lipids and experimentally evaluated LNP biodistribution, efficiency, and cell-specific gene silencing.
identifiable_lnp_evidence: The tested LNPs vary pH-sensitive lipid chemistry, pKa, lipase sensitivity, and particle size.
target_cell_evidence_text: The study directly reports gene-silencing efficiency and specificity in LSECs.
formulation_outcome_linkage_evidence: Changes in lipid pKa, lipase sensitivity, and particle size are linked to intrahepatic localization and LSEC-specific gene silencing.
notes: Included for detailed extraction. The relevant endpoint family is gene_knockdown.

original_experiment_evidence: The study reports in-vivo HIRI mouse experiments and in-vitro LSEC experiments involving siMicu1 lipid nanoparticles.
identifiable_lnp_evidence: The experimental intervention is identified as siMicu1 lipid nanoparticles, although exact composition requires full-text extraction.
supported_payload_evidence: The siMicu1 payload is an siRNA intervention targeting Micu1.
target_cell_evidence_text: The study evaluates siMicu1 LNPs in an LSEC-specific experimental context and measures LSEC damage and anti-HIRI effects.
formulation_outcome_linkage_evidence: siMicu1 lipid nanoparticles are linked to enhanced anti-HIRI effects when combined with acteoside.
notes: Include only the siMicu1-LNP experimental arm; acteoside-only evidence is outside the LNP formulation dataset.

original_experiment_evidence: The study experimentally investigated high-dose LNP toxicity and tested GalNAc- and PEG-modified siRNA-LNP formulations.
identifiable_lnp_evidence: The study compares hepatotropic LNPs, GalNAc-modified LNPs, and PEG-modified GalNAc-LNPs.
target_cell_evidence_text: The study reports LNP accumulation in LSECs, LSEC activation, cytokine induction, and subsequent neutrophilic inflammation.
formulation_outcome_linkage_evidence: GalNAc and PEG modifications are linked to hepatocyte specificity, reduced LSEC-associated toxicity, and maintained gene-silencing activity.
notes: Included for LSEC evidence because LNP accumulation and toxicity are directly measured; the improved formulation primarily targets hepatocytes.

original_experiment_evidence: The study tested CD163 antibody-conjugated LNPs carrying FAP-specific CAR-macrophage mRNA and measured macrophage and fibrosis outcomes.
identifiable_lnp_evidence: The tested system is identified as alpha-CD163/LNP-FAPCAR.
supported_payload_evidence: The LNP encapsulates mRNA encoding a FAP-specific chimeric antigen receptor.
target_cell_evidence_text: Activated HSCs are described as FAP-positive fibrosis-driving cells, but the abstract does not clearly report a directly measured HSC-specific outcome after treatment.
formulation_outcome_linkage_evidence: The alpha-CD163/LNP-FAPCAR intervention is linked to macrophage transduction, increased phagocytic capacity, reduced ECM, and fibrosis resolution.
notes: Inspect full text for direct identification and measurement of activated HSCs as treatment targets.

original_experiment_evidence: The study experimentally tested CD47-modified and antibody-targeted mRNA LNPs in vitro and in vivo.
identifiable_lnp_evidence: The tested platform is identified as a CD47-modified, antibody-targeted LNP carrying mRNA.
supported_payload_evidence: The LNP payload is mRNA, including pro-apoptotic mRNA.
target_cell_evidence_text: HSC refers to hematopoietic stem cells used in bone-marrow-transplant preconditioning, not hepatic stellate cells.
formulation_outcome_linkage_evidence: CD47 and antibody modifications are linked to macrophage uptake, hepatic uptake, cell targeting, inflammation, and mRNA delivery outcomes.
notes: Irrelevant HSC acronym match: hematopoietic stem cell, not hepatic stellate cell.

target_cell_evidence_text: HSC refers to hematopoietic stem cells used for bone-marrow engraftment, not hepatic stellate cells.
formulation_outcome_linkage_evidence: The CD117-targeted Cre-mRNA LNP is linked to alpha-globin deletion and the resulting mouse disease-model outcomes.
notes: Irrelevant HSC acronym match: hematopoietic stem cell, not hepatic stellate cell.

supported_payload_evidence: The LNP systems deliver mRNA for CRISPR, base editing, and Cre-mediated deletion.
